name: category
title: Category
description: Named colors that tell which category a piece of data belongs to.
use: A project, a calendar, a label or any set of data told apart by color, always beside its name. Put a category-<name> class on the row, card or event that belongs to the category, or on the part itself; badge-category, chip-category, schedule-event-category and icon-frame-category read it, and nothing else does. A status (done, failing, at risk) is a tone such as badge-success, not a category.

instead.when: The color says how something is (success, warning, danger), not what it belongs to
The color is the content itself, such as a paint or a theme being chosen

properties.name: --category-surface
properties.description: The tinted surface of a category part. Set by every category-<name> class; a part without one falls back to its neutral surface

properties.name: --category-text
properties.description: Text on the category surface; 4.5:1 against it and against the base and raised faces

properties.name: --category-line
properties.description: A decorative contour around the category surface; it is never the only edge of a control

properties.name: --category-mark
properties.description: A dot or a bar that marks the category; 3:1 against the category surface and the base and raised faces
